candidates.statement: Fix a cutoff q (models with unique fillers above q). Prove 'J_n-expansions are weak equivalences' for n = q, q-1, ..., 0. At index n, build coglobular objects P_j: P_j = D_j for j<n (stationary), P_n = D_{n+1} (one joining cell), and for n<j<=q a small-object completion of the two-sided boundary datum against upper I_k. Their contractibility (and that of P(S)) follows from the already-proved higher-index expansions via whiskered shapes and skeletal gluing. Contractibility lets every coherator operation be interpreted on Hom(P_j, Y) in the free order, giving a partial path functor whose endpoints lift I_j and jointly lift J_n; a retract argument closes the step.

Here the cylinders depend on the fixed cutoff and expansion index'; 00 intro: 'His construction leaves the extension to compatible interpretations of all higher operations open. The partial paths used here are adapted to one expansion index at a time: the already established higher-index expansions make their representing objects contractible'; 'Their study of coskeletal and truncated globular models also supplies context for the cutoffs' (Henry-Lanari).
test1.verdict: No equivalent found. 2026-10-12 full-text re-check: Lanari 2018's 'slightly less than a path object' is a full-cylinder path object on C^W-models (theory-level weakening), and Taylor 2609.20860 is a re-presentation of Lanari's full cylinder; neither has cylinders partial in an expansion index, contractibility drawn from higher-index cases, or a descending induction. Lanari 2020, Henry-Lanari 2023 and Henry 2016 confirmed as ingredient-only. Every ingredient still has a named precedent; the coupling remains unprecedented in the checked literature. Residual risk: unread literature outside this cluster, expert folklore, Test 4.

test2.evidence: The goal (i : X -> X+ is a weak equivalence for a J_n pushout) mentions no cylinder, path object, cutoff or induction order. L does contain 'path object => pushout lemma' (Henry 2016, Lanari 2020) and Lanari's full cylinders, so the generic path-object component is analytic relative to L; the partial (stationary below n), index-tailored objects and the descending order at fixed q are not subterms of the goal or of any L statement found. Syntactic size irrelevant: P_j for j<=n is trivial (D_j, D_{n+1}); the content is the choice.

Lean: cylinderPathData has dominated share 0.648 of the 856-declaration proof DAG, and cutoff_elementary_exactBoundaryTest (0.735) contains it. test4.pivot_distance: about 2 from L: from Lanari's stated obstruction (interpreting all operations needs contractible representing objects) and Henry's reduction, one must (a) give up the full path object for one tailored to a single expansion index n (stationary below n), and (b) see that its upper contractibility is exactly the higher-index cases, which requires (c) a cutoff q to start a descending induction. (c) is one step from Henry-Lanari's coskeletal models.

final.justification: Eureka CANDIDATE only. 2026-10-12 full-text re-check cleared the two named downgrade risks (Lanari 2018, Taylor 2609.20860), so confidence rises 0.35 -> 0.45; it does not rise further because Test 4 is not run, no expert has classified the scheme, and the templated-IH-strengthening reading (falls_to (d)) is untouched by literature checks. Non-analytic in its partial/descending form (test 2) though the path-object strategy is in L; strongly load-bearing (test 3, 65% dominated share). F3: P_j are auxiliary objects built only for the proof; F2: the scheme turns the theorem's own higher-index cases into the input that makes them contractible. Kept at N3 rather than capped because the cap targets templated IH strengthenings, and here the new content is the auxiliary object whose contractibility the reversed induction supplies; the descending order alone (C3) is capped at N2 (Lanari 2018 Lemma 6.1/5.4 confirm the 'top dimension free by truncation' ingredient). Comparable in shape to Cook's device (cheap objects, P_j trivial below n, that cut an obstruction open since 2016/2018), but no downstream reuse is known yet; 317's stationary cylinders are an analogue, not a reuse of the bootstrap.

family_D.rests_on: C1 alone: the scheme 'index-n partial cylinders whose representing objects are contractible by the higher-index cases of a descending induction at a fixed coskeletal cutoff'. Every component graded separately (C2-C10) is N2 or below.
family_D.falls_to: D2 if (a) [CHECKED 2026-10-12, not triggered for Taylor 2609.20860, Lanari 2018, Lanari 2020, Henry-Lanari 2023 or Henry 2016 Sec 4.2/5.3] some other text contains a path-like object partial in the expansion index with contractibility drawn from higher-dimensional cases; (b) Test 4 shows pre-cutoff models, given Lanari's stated obstruction and Henry's path-object reduction, propose 'only build the path object needed for index n and get its fillers from higher indices'; (c) an expert classifies it as the standard 'induction downward from a truncation' pattern already used in finite-dimensional (n-groupoid) cases; or (d) the scheme is judged a templated IH strengthening in substance (the cap), since its only role is to make the IH self-feeding.
family_D.not_transfer: Ingredients are transfer/N0 or variants: Lanari cylinders, homotopy rel boundary (stationary cylinders), coskeletal reflection (Henry-Lanari), contractible-coglobular interpretation (Ara, Bourke, Lumsdaine/van den Berg-Garner), small object argument, path-object retract argument (Quillen/Brown). D3 rests only on their coupling and order, so the cross-field exclusion does not apply; but the cross-field count is 1 and no new bridge exists.
family_D.correctness_caveat: Theorem 1.1 is Lean-backed and trusted as published (no IsCoherator instance is constructed, so non-vacuity is not formally shown; risk low). The homotopy hypothesis (title) is unformalized and rests on Henry 2016 plus a claimed typo fix in Henry's Lemma 5.3.11. Unreviewed; no expert reaction found.
family_D.speedup_note: The device is tailored to a single conjecture. Downstream reuse targets must be theorems other than Thm 1.1 and its corollaries (Cor 5.1/5.2, coherator independence, Taylor Thm 5.8 in the Ara-Henry convention are corollaries and do not count). Candidates: the pushout lemma for Grothendieck n-groupoids at finite n (Henry-Lanari; gives an internal-consistency check), coherators outside the arity-height convention (Maltsiniotis), Taylor's controlled theories / generalized pushout conjecture beyond the Ara-Henry convention, Grothendieck-Maltsiniotis (infinity,n)-categories, and family 317's strict Thomason setting (already solved without it - a negative control).
family_D.verified_2026_10_12: Full-text re-check of Lanari 2018 and Taylor 2609.20860 (plus Lanari 2020, Henry-Lanari 2023, Henry 2016 spot checks): only ingredients, no index-partial cylinders bootstrapped by descending induction. D3 (provisional) kept; confidence 0.35 -> 0.45. Remaining downgrade routes: (b) Test 4, (c) expert folklore, (d) IH-strengthening cap.

verified_checks.source: Lanari, 'A semi-model structure for Grothendieck weak 3-groupoids'
verified_checks.what_was_read: arXiv abstract page (only v1, 21 Sep 2018; PDF dated 31 Jul 2021) + full PDF via pdftotext: Sec 1 introduction, Thm 3.1, all of Sec 4 (Def 4.3, Thm 4.4, Prop 4.5-4.9, Thm 4.10, Remark 4.11), Lemma 5.4, Sec 5.3 (cylinders, Def 5.8), Sec 5.6 (division lemma), Sec 6 opening and Thm 6.10/Cor 6.11; keyword scan of the rest (partial, induction, contractib, truncat, coskelet, slightly).
verified_checks.finding: 'Slightly less than a path object' means: a functorial path object P with ev: P => Id x Id (pointwise fibration, ev_i trivial fibrations) on models of C^W = a coherator for n-CATEGORIES with freely adjoined left/right inverses (Def 4.3, Thm 4.4), instead of on Grothendieck n-groupoids; Remark 4.11 adds that it suffices to lift P to Mod(C) (~ infinity-Cat), given the division lemma (Sec 5.6, which Lanari could not prove for C^W in general). The weakening is in the AMBIENT THEORY (categorical operations + weak inverses instead of all groupoidal coherences), not in dimension. The object is always the FULL cylinder Cyl(D_k) of [EL]=Lanari 2020, in every dimension k; PX_k = Mod(C3^W)(Cyl(D_k), X). The dim-3 construction climbs the coherator tower C1->C2->C3->C4 (ascending in operation dimension); the top step is automatic by truncation (Lemma 6.1, cylinders with equal boundary are equal) and Lemma 5.4 (k-spheres in a globular sum of dim n fill for k >= n). No cylinders that are trivial/stationary below a working index, no expansion index, no use of the pushout lemma in higher dimensions to make representing objects contractible, no descending induction. Ingredients only: (i) path object => pushout lemma / semi-model structure (Thm 3.1/Lemma 3.4 is the same retract argument as 312's C9), (ii) full Lanari cylinders, (iii) 'top dimension is free by truncation' used once in a fixed finite dimension (a weak precursor of 312's top case E(q,q), not a bootstrap).
verbatim_quotes: "the obstruction in arbitrary dimension (possibly infinite) only resides in the construction of (slightly less than) a path object on a suitable category of Grothendieck (weak) n-categories with weak inverses" (abstract)
"it is enough to construct such map for a globular theory obtained from a coherator for n-categories ... by freely adjoining a left and a right inverse for each map" (Sec 4)
"It turns out that extending along i3 is automatic" (Sec 6, via Lemma 6.1)
"The proof of this lemma requires contractibility, and we were not able to generalize it to CW" (Sec 5.6, division lemma)
verified_checks.ai_disclosure: n/a (2018; no AI mention; no acknowledgements section)
verified_checks.effect_on_grade: Removes the 'largest unread risk' for C1: not a close variant. The weakening is orthogonal (theory-level, not index-partial). C1 stays N3 candidate. Lanari 2018 confirms (a) the full path object is the community target and (b) the truncation top case is known in fixed finite dimension (supports C3's N2 template cap).

verified_checks.what_was_read: arXiv abstract page (v1, 8 Sep 2026, 25 KB, math.AT, no comments field) + full PDF (24 pp.) via pdftotext, read in full: introduction, acknowledgements/remarks, Secs 1-3, Thm 3.11, references.
verified_checks.finding: A re-presentation of Lanari's FULL cylinder co-globular object in co-globular infinity-groupoids M = [G, inftyGpd] over the algebraic coherator AC: C(0) = D_bullet + D_bullet, C(n+1) = pushout along the projective generating cofibration F_n(S^n) -> F_n(D^{n+1}) of the sphere beta_n built from algebraic whiskerings lambda_n, rho_n; Cyl = colim C(n), Cyl_n = C_n^(n+1); Prop 3.10: D+D -> Cyl is a pointwise cofibration; Thm 3.11: Cyl iso to Lanari's E (proof is a 2-line sketch citing Lanari 2020 diagrams). The intermediate stages C(n) are stationary/fixed below level n in the sense C_t^(m) = C_t^(t+1) for t < m-1 -- a staged construction in ASCENDING n with no contractibility statement. Nothing on: contractibility of the representing objects, interpretation of coherator operations on Hom(Cyl, X), the pushout lemma/conjecture, an expansion index, a coskeletal cutoff, or any induction that uses higher-dimensional cases. It is strictly an alternative construction of the object Lanari already had.
verbatim_quotes: "We provide a new presentation for a cylinder object inside of the category of co-globular infinity-groupoids. We prove that the cylinder construction that Lanari provides is isomorphic to the one we build in this paper." (abstract)
"we inductively construct a chain inside of the category of co-globular infinity-groupoids whose colimit we call the cylinder object" (intro)
"3.11. Theorem. There is an isomorphism of co-globular infinity groupoids phi : Cyl -> E, where E is the cylinder construction given by Lanari."
verified_checks.ai_disclosure: None. Acknowledgements thank the author's husband and 'Simon Henry for all of our back and forth conversations on this topic' (human workflow signal). 'Remarks about Work from the Author' says the algebraic coherator 'has been the coherator that I have had the most success working with in Python script' -- computational aid, not AI assistance. No mention of AI, LLMs, ChatGPT/GPT/OpenAI. Author unaffiliated (Chicago).
verified_checks.effect_on_grade: Not a precedent for C1 (full cylinders only; no bootstrap, no pushout lemma); confirms C2's 'close variant' status for the bare object (Lanari/Taylor full cylinders + stationary below n). No effect on C1's N3; C2 stays N2. For Test 4 contamination control 2609.20860 can be dropped as the binding cutoff (it contains none of (a)-(c) of the P-C1 equivalence), but keeping it excluded is harmless.
